title: Grunge/Distressed
content: Apply grunge aesthetic with intentionally rough, rebellious feel. Add distressed textures: scratches, noise, worn paper effects. Use irregular, hand-drawn or typewriter fonts. Include splatter and ink blot decorations. Dark, muted color palette: browns, blacks, dark reds, olive. Torn paper and rough edges on elements. Layered, collage-like compositions. Anti-corporate, DIY punk aesthetic. Vintage photograph treatments with high grain.

variants.simple: Create rough, rebellious grunge aesthetic with textures, worn edges, and raw typography.
variants.detailed: Apply grunge aesthetic with intentionally rough, rebellious feel. Add distressed textures: scratches, noise, worn paper effects. Use irregular, hand-drawn or typewriter fonts. Include splatter and ink blot decorations. Dark, muted color palette: browns, blacks, dark reds, olive. Torn paper and rough edges on elements. Layered, collage-like compositions. Anti-corporate, DIY punk aesthetic. Vintage photograph treatments with high grain.
variants.advanced: Apply grunge aesthetic with intentionally rough, rebellious, underground feel. Textures: distressed overlays using SVG filters or pseudo-elements - scratches, noise (grain effect via tiny dot pattern), worn/aged paper, concrete, rust. Apply mix-blend-mode for texture layering. Typography: irregular fonts - typewriter (Courier, Special Elite), hand-drawn (Permanent Marker), distressed display fonts. Vary baseline, size, and rotation for chaotic feel. Ink effects: splatter decorations (SVG), ink blots, drips, stains as background elements. Color palette: muted, dirty tones - browns (amber-900), blacks, dried blood red (rose-900), olive (stone-700), faded yellow (amber-200). Edges: torn paper effect using clip-path or SVG mask, rough borders, tape strips. Composition: layered collage style, overlapping elements, intentional messiness. Photography: high contrast, heavy grain (CSS filter: contrast(1.2) grayscale(0.3)), vintage fading. Stickers and labels: peeling, worn appearances. DIY aesthetic: visible staples, paper clips, hand-written notes. Background: aged paper texture, coffee stains, fold marks. Interactive: elements can tear away, reveal layers beneath. Performance: texture images can be heavy - optimize with CSS patterns where possible. Accessibility: despite chaotic appearance, maintain readable contrast for essential text.

author: Ersin KOÇ
